evidence.title: GuidedFlow: An Attention-Guided Framework for Anomaly Detection in Additive Manufacturing

summary: A new attention-guided AI framework, GuidedFlow, aims to improve anomaly detection in additive manufacturing processes. The system leverages deep learning to identify defects in real-time, enhancing quality control in industrial 3D printing.
title: Researchers Introduce GuidedFlow: AI Framework for Detecting Anomalies in 3D Printing
